title: galium boreale var. hyssopifolium
intro: Galium boreale var. hyssopifolium, commonly known as American Sweetroot, is a plant species within the Rubiaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of digestive issues, such as diarrhea and dysentery, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of American Sweetroot are attributed to its ability to soothe the digestive system, reduce inflammation, and promote wound healing. Bioactive constituents of the plant include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
